dog_points: points the BACKED side was getting before kickoff; the stored pregame spread is home-relative, so the away side's value is its negation

validation.method: fit on the first half of 2025, read on the second; never both
validation.note: plain Platt barely moves; the pregame term is what carries it

defect: measured on 2025: the model under-rates favourites and over-rates underdogs, monotonically. Backed side laying 14+ claims 0.890 wins 0.955; getting 7-14 claims 0.291 wins 0.207; a >=14pt dog that is AHEAD claims 0.239 wins 0.121 (interval [0.060,0.229] excludes the claim). Calibration by CURRENT LEAD is inside its interval in every bucket, so the defect is the pregame dimension only.

shipped_cut.note: SWEPT ON THE CORRECTED SCALE. Stage 3 changes what model_probability means, so a cut swept on raw probabilities is the wrong number on the wrong scale -- the raw-scale 0.68 took 2 bets on the held-out half and lost both. On corrected probabilities: 33 bets +25.7%, halves +23.8%/+34.2%, and the four neighbouring cells (0.62/0.26, 0.65/0.22, 0.65/0.30, 0.60/0.26) are all positive in both halves. A plateau, where the raw scale only had islands.
